scenarios.name: strong_stable_control
scenarios.description: Positive control: strong semantic signal, stable enrollment, few missed cover observations, fixed eight-client population.

scenarios.name: strong_churn_control
scenarios.description: Positive control: strong semantic signal under substantial enrollment churn and a changing client population.

scenarios.name: weaker_semantic_beacon
scenarios.description: Reduced semantic signal with moderate false positives; stable population and low churn.

scenarios.name: high_beacon_noise
scenarios.description: Weak distinction between beacon events and non-events, with otherwise stable enrollment.

scenarios.name: high_enrollment_churn
scenarios.description: Strong beacon semantics but rapid enrollment state changes and moderate missed cover observations.

scenarios.name: high_missed_cover
scenarios.description: Strong beacon semantics with frequent missed cover observations.

scenarios.name: changing_population
scenarios.description: Strong signal with client populations varying from four to sixteen candidates between whole sessions.

scenarios.name: combined_adverse_conditions
scenarios.description: Reduced semantic signal combined with churn, missed cover observations, and changing client populations.
